translations.web: and one male goat for a sin offering; in addition to the continual burnt offering, its meal offering, and its drink offering.
translations.bsb: Include one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular burnt offering with its grain offering and drink offering.
translations.kjv: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, his meat offering, and his drink offering.
translations.asv: and one he-goat for a sin-offering; besides the continual burnt-offering, the meal-offering thereof, and the drink-offering thereof.
